title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 08
passage:
When you pick up a packet in a supermarket, the front is designed to {{1}} your attention. Words such as 'natural' or 'light' are chosen to sound healthy, but they have no {{2}} legal meaning in many countries. The information that really matters is printed on the back, often in very small type.

Learning to read a label takes only a few minutes. First, check the size of the portion the numbers {{3}} to. A bag that seems to contain 200 calories may in fact hold three portions. Second, compare the same kind of product rather than two different foods, because {{4}} values are easier to judge.

Nutritionists advise shoppers to {{5}} products with a long list of unfamiliar ingredients. Usually a short list means the food has been processed less. They also {{6}} that sugar appears under many names, so a product may contain three kinds of sweetener and still look {{7}} at first glance.

Food companies argue that labels give consumers {{8}} to make their own choices. Campaigners agree in principle but want the {{9}} to be clearer. Until then, shoppers can protect themselves with one simple {{10}}: turn the packet over and read the small print before you decide.

blanks.explain: 选 A. attract。attract attention 意为吸引注意力，与主语 the front of a packet 搭配；maintain 意为维持，无法与 attention 构成吸引之意。
选 J. precise。no precise legal meaning 意为没有明确的法律含义，修饰 legal meaning 最贴切；generous 意为慷慨的，与此处语义无关。
选 K. refer。refer to 意为指的是，此处说明包装上的数字对应的是哪一份的量；decline 意为下降，不能与 to 构成此义。
选 M. similar。similar values 意为相近的数值，同类产品的营养成分更容易比较；frequently 是副词，不能修饰名词 values。
选 B. avoid。avoid products 意为避开这类产品，与前文「成分表越短加工越少」的观点一致；maintain products 搭配不当。
选 N. warn。warn that 意为提醒、警告，营养学家提醒消费者糖会以多种名称出现；decline 后接 that 从句表示拒绝，语义不符。
选 H. harmless。look harmless 意为看起来无害，与前面暗中含多种甜味剂形成对比；generous 不能描述食品是否无害。
选 F. freedom。give sb freedom to do sth 意为给予某人做某事的自由，符合食品公司为标签辩护的立场；budget 指预算，与选择权无关。
选 O. wording。the wording 指标签上的措辞，与 clearer 搭配自然；budget 与措辞是否清晰无关。
选 L. rule。one simple rule 意为一条简单的规则，冒号后正是这条规则的内容；maintain 是动词，不能作介词 with 的宾语。
